papers.title_en: Agentic University: Collaborative Agents for Personalized Learning
papers.authors: Jingru Fan, Tianle Zhou, Yunjie Zhou, Zihao He, Yixuan Zhou, Kezhao Wu, Xinyu Zheng, Xiyuan Wang, Yuheng Wang, Zhi Li, Songhua Liu, Weinan E, Chen Qian
papers.evidence: 多智能体个性化学习组织
papers.tldr: 大语言模型可支持个性化辅导，但目标、活动与评估难以形成随学习者演化的连贯学习过程。作者提出人类参与式多智能体组织，并落地为Agentic University，让学习者与专门智能体共同维护可修订的能力项目。评估中，用户在项目组织、评估设计与修订质量上占优，平均评估增益12.19分，高于对照的5.61分（50分制）。该工作以组织化多智能体协调支持自适应学习，使学习者参与成为持续基础。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models support personalized tutoring, content generation, and adaptive learning paths. However, capability development requires these resources and interactions to form a coherent learning process that evolves with the learner. A central challenge is to align goals, activities, and assessment while using learning evidence to decide what should follow. We introduce Human-Participatory Multi-Agent Organization and instantiate it in Agentic University (AU). In AU, learners participate as organization members and work with specialized agents to maintain a revisable Capability Program. The program connects personal goals, learning activities across modalities, and layered assessment, while learner feedback and performance guide subsequent support. Our evaluation shows advantages in program organization, assessment design, and revision quality. Users achieved larger mean assessment gains (12.19 versus 5.61 points on a 50-point scale) and reported stronger cognitive support. This work contributes an organizational approach to adaptive learning that makes learner participation a continuing basis for multi-agent coordination. The Agentic University project is available at \href{https://github.com/AgenticOrgLab/AgenticUniversity.git}.

papers.title_en: Student-LLM Interactions During Math Learning: Limited Epistemic Proactivity Overall, but Within-chat Change Predicts Performance Without AI
papers.authors: Rania Abdelghani, Peter Kaiser, Kou Murayama
papers.evidence: 数学学习中与大模型交互的分析
papers.tldr: 研究关注学生与LLM协作学习时能否保持认识论主动性，并分析112名中学生使用Mistral完成开放式数学建模的880个实质对话轮次。总体上互动以请求为主，计划、监控和评价较少；低质量AI回应会引发更多明确评价。求助策略随对话变得较少理解导向，但其时间轨迹能预测无AI后测表现，越趋理解导向者表现越好。研究强调应关注主动性的时间组织，而非孤立提示类型。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for learning, raising a key question: can learners remain epistemically proactive, retaining responsibility for the cognitive and regulatory activities through which learning is produced while working with AI? Because this responsibility may change as interactions unfold, we examine epistemic proactivity as a developing process. We conceptualize epistemic proactivity through self-regulated learning (SRL) moves, complemented by help-seeking strategies and manifestations of epistemic vigilance. We analyzed these behaviors in 880 substantive turns from 112 secondary-school students completing open-ended mathematical-modeling practice with a general-purpose LLM (Mistral). Overall, students showed limited observable epistemic proactivity: their interactions were strongly request-dominated, with planning, monitoring, and evaluation relatively rare, although low-quality AI responses elicited more explicit evaluation. Temporal analyses qualified this picture: explicit SRL-related moves increased modestly over the chat, but help-seeking strategies became less understanding-oriented. Crucially, these temporal trajectories in help-seeking strategies predicted their post-test performance without AI beyond pre-test and aggregate patterns: students whose requests became more understanding-oriented performed better once AI assistance was removed. Thus, while students had a limited epistemic proactivity overall, its temporal development still was a critical predictor of post-test performance without AI. These results underscore the importance of examining the temporal organization of epistemic proactivity, rather than isolated prompt types, for understanding AI-supported learning. We release our fully-anonymized dataset publicly in an OSF repository.

papers.title_en: Exploring AI Peer in Collaborative Mathematics Learning
papers.authors: Yiran Lin, Ye Deng, Ziqi Pan, Yongan Yu, Alexandra I. Cristea
papers.evidence: 将自适应大模型同伴代理用于协作数学学习环境
papers.tldr: 研究关注协作数学学习中AI如何被识别为同伴，而非仅看解题能力。作者构建结合大五人格与动机状态调节的自适应LLM同伴，邀请领域专家开展访谈并做主题分析。结果显示专家主要依据社会行为判断同伴性：非评判空间、试探性推理、适度不完美和尊重节奏提升同伴感，盲从与过度指导则削弱信任并转向导师角色。研究据此提出以人为中心的AI同伴设计维度。
papers.abstract_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) agents are increasingly explored as collaborative learning partners in mathematics education, yet it remains unclear what makes an AI recognizable as a peer. This study examines how domain experts perceive and interact with an adaptive LLM-based peer agent combining a Big Five-informed persona with motivational state modulation for collaborative mathematics problem solving. Through thematic analysis of expert interviews, we identify conditions shaping peer perceptions, including emotional safety, shared control, and collaborative reasoning. Participants primarily judged the AI through its social behavior rather than mathematical capabilities. The AI was perceived more as a peer when it created a non-judgmental space, engaged in tentative reasoning, displayed appropriate imperfection, and respected participants' pace. Conversely, blind agreement and over-instruction reduced trust and shifted perceptions toward a tutor role. Based on these findings, we propose human-centered design dimensions for AI peer agents to guide future peer-oriented learning systems.

papers.title_en: Generative artificial intelligence prompting strategies among Chinese university students across academic tasks
papers.evidence: 大学生在不同学术任务中的生成式AI提示策略
papers.tldr: 生成式人工智能日益融入大学学习，但有效人机互动不仅依赖工具可及性，更取决于学生的提示能力。研究基于234名中国大学生的问卷，结合描述统计、测量建模、情境比较、结构关联与开放评论编码。结果显示学生总体自信，能提供上下文并迭代优化，但提示策略对任务类型不敏感，固定模板认可度较低。研究揭示了提示能力与策略特征，为GenAI教学支持提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) is increasingly embedded in university learning, yet effective human-GenAI interaction depends not only on access to these tools but also on students' ability to formulate, evaluate, and refine prompts for academic tasks. This study examined university students' perceived GenAI prompting capability and reported prompting strategies. Questionnaire data from 234 students were analyzed using descriptive statistics, measurement modelling, scenario comparisons, structural associations, and qualitative coding of optional comments. Students reported using GenAI across diverse academic activities and generally expressed confidence in their prompting capabilities, particularly in providing relevant context and refining prompts following initial outputs. However, prompting strategies showed limited sensitivity to task types: specifying output format was more strongly endorsed in a creative workshop preparation scenario than in a research-oriented assignment, whereas other matched strategies showed no adjusted differences. Students also commonly endorsed both concise instructions and providing all relevant information at the outset, suggesting that effective brevity may depend more on selecting and organizing task-relevant information than on prompt length alone. By contrast, fixed prompt templates received lower endorsement than other prompting strategies. In the adopted factor model, perceived cognition showed the clearest unique association with perceived prompting capability, while open-ended responses highlighted prompt-intent alignment as a common challenge.

papers.title_en: AI Cosmos: An Agentic Infra for Situated Learning
papers.authors: AI Cosmos Team, Jinfeng Zhou, Yuxuan Chen, Fangming Chang, Mingyu Su, Yifan Zhu, Yuan Wang, Bo Zhang, Bosi Wen, Chenhao Yuan, Chenwen Liao, Dazhi Jiang, Deyao Hong, Erle Zhu, Genrui Zhang, Guchan Li, Hongwen Gan, Huichao Bi, Jiahao Yan, Jincheng Fan, Kehan Zheng, Qinren Luo, Qiran Liu, Ruoqi Cao, Shizhi Zhang, Sihan Chen, Siyan Deng, Xuehan Zhou, Xujun Li, Yang Dang, Yanzhuo Zhu, Yu Zhang, Zheyu Chen, Hongning Wang, Manli Li
papers.evidence: 基于大模型智能体的情境学习基础设施
papers.tldr: 现有LLM辅导虽能提升学习中的任务表现，却未必带来独立迁移能力。AI Cosmos以场景化参与和累积式实践资产构建智能体基础设施，让学习者与角色化智能体在含知识及可执行工作台的场景中协作，并用资产记忆循环保留实践过程与产物。两项预注册随机对照实验显示，其在法律推理上的学习增益超过常规LLM，在未见编程题上的掌握度超过LLM-as-Teacher基线。该工作为情境化学习提供了可复用、可追踪的智能体基础设施。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can improve task performance during learning, yet these gains do not necessarily reflect learners' ability to thereafter apply the knowledge and skills independently. We present AI Cosmos, an agentic infrastructure for situated learning that organizes learning around two complementary principles: scenario-based participation and cumulative assets of practice. AI Cosmos organizes learners and role-specialized agents within learning scenarios that integrate task-relevant knowledge and, when needed, executable workbenches. An asset-memory loop preserves the processes and outcomes of practice as reusable assets with explicit provenance and dependencies. We evaluate scenario-based interaction through two preregistered randomized controlled studies examining the acquisition of legal reasoning and programming competence, holding the same underlying LLM across conditions. AI Cosmos achieves greater learning gains than a conventional LLM in legal reasoning and higher mastery of unseen programming problems than an LLM-as-Teacher baseline.

papers.title_en: The generative paradox: the Anti-Prompt paradigm for human capability
papers.evidence: 教育中的生成式AI与以保留人类能力为设计目标
papers.tldr: 生成式AI教育常只看人机团队产出，忽视辅助变化或消失后人类仍能理解、质疑、修复和适应什么，作者称此张力为生成悖论并区分四种表现。提出发展性功能分配，把保留人类能力与当前协同绩效并列为设计目标，并设计Anti-Prompt范式反转默认交互顺序，让AI先为关键人类建构创造条件。通过代表性Anti-Prompt、规范交互序列及数学推理、实验科学、软件诊断、课程设计压力测试具体化区分，并给出可证伪预测与专长再生产分配的系统假设。
papers.abstract_en: Generative AI in education is usually judged by the output of human-AI teams. That focus overlooks a second outcome: what people can still understand, challenge, repair, and adapt when assistance changes or disappears. We call this tension the generative paradox and distinguish four manifestations: performance, assistance, ownership, and capability stock. We propose developmental function allocation, which complements operational function allocation and meaningful human control by treating retained human capability as a design objective alongside current joint performance. The Anti-Prompt paradigm reverses the default interaction order: when immediate generation would preempt a consequential human act, AI should first create the conditions for human construction. We distinguish the validity of a product, responsibility for its construction, and evidence of capability after support changes. Representative Anti-Prompts, a canonical interaction sequence, and stress tests spanning mathematical reasoning, experimental science, software diagnosis, and lesson design make these distinctions concrete. We conclude with falsifiable predictions about retained capability and a system-level hypothesis about the reproduction and distribution of expertise.

papers.title_en: When Does GenAI Use Support Critical Thinking? A Cross-Cultural Structural Account of Transactive Memory with GenAI
papers.evidence: 学生学业中生成式AI使用与批判性思维
papers.tldr: 生成式AI使用能否促进批判性思维仍有争议，既有研究多关注工具暴露而非使用结构。本文把交互记忆系统理论扩展到人机协作，以美土891名大学生检验结构模型。结果显示，自我评估思维力与协作信心只影响GenAI实践经验，经验须经认知劳动分工协调和主动改写输出才关联批判性思维。跨文化多组比较表明该结构大体稳定，仅两处理论可解释差异，为GenAI辅助学习提供结构性解释。
papers.abstract_en: Whether generative AI (GenAI) use helps or hinders critical thinking remains contested, and existing accounts emphasize exposure to the tool rather than how a person structures their engagement with it. Extending Transactive Memory Systems (TMS) theory to human-AI partnerships, we test a structural account of critical thinking in GenAI-assisted academic work among 891 college students in the United States and Türkiye. Self-appraised thinking ability and confidence in the partnership shaped how much practical experience a person built up with GenAI, but neither predicted critical thinking directly. That experience mattered only through two downstream behaviors, dividing and coordinating cognitive labor with the tool, and actively reworking its output rather than accepting it as given. A multigroup comparison found this structure largely invariant, with two theoretically interpretable exceptions. This study offers a structural, TMS-based account of critical thinking in GenAI-assisted work.

papers.title_en: Beyond Aggregate WER: In-domain Adaptation, Learner Speech, Code-Switching, and Speaker Attribution in Online Spanish Learning Classrooms
papers.authors: Olga Kellert, Samhitha Harish, Johnatan E Bonilla, Nemika Tyagi, Phanos Kareen, Nelvin Licona-Guevara
papers.evidence: 面向在线语言学习课堂的语音识别评测
papers.tldr: 聚合WER会掩盖学习者语音、语码转换和说话人归属中的错误，使教育ASR的真实难点被平均指标遮蔽。研究在在线L2西班牙语课堂比较平台集成、开放权重、域内适配和商业ASR，并用LoRA对Whisper large-v3与MOSS进行适配。结果显示MOSS适配在说话角色和语言语境上稳定提升，域匹配比数据量更关键，开放模型在WER/CER上接近商业系统。研究贡献在于倡导条件感知评估和交互匹配数据，以改进双语教育ASR。
papers.abstract_en: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) increasingly supplies transcripts for educational NLP, but aggregate word error rate (WER) can conceal errors concentrated in learner speech, multilingual turns, and speaker attribution. We compare platform-integrated, open-weight, adapted, and commercial ASR configurations on held-out sessions of online L2 Spanish interaction between L1 English learners and their instructors and tutors. Because English is the learner's shared first language, the interactions contain Spanish-only, English-only, and code-switched turns. Evaluation combines overall WER and character error rate (CER), WER disaggregated by speaker role and language context, and diarization error rate (DER). We also adapt Whisper large-v3 and MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize with LoRA using human-corrected in-domain classroom data. MOSS adaptation produced consistent improvements across speaker roles and language contexts, whereas Whisper showed smaller gains. Domain match proved more important than data volume: Larger out-of-domain bilingual and learner corpora did not outperform the smaller classroom corpus, where learner speech and code-switching are embedded in instructor--learner interaction. The open-weight MOSS adapter was competitive with commercial Muse Voice Transcribe on WER and CER and achieved lower system-provided DER on the recordings eligible for each system. Learner, English-only, and code-switched speech remained more difficult than instructor and Spanish-only speech. The findings demonstrate the value of condition-aware evaluation and interactionally matched data for bilingual educational ASR.
